title: MiniSWE setup ignores failed setup commands
reasoning: Environment execution returns command output with a returncode, but setup discards each result. A setup command that exits nonzero therefore does not stop subsequent commands or prevent setup from returning successfully. The agent can start against an incompletely prepared environment, confounding benchmark results with infrastructure failures.
reproduction: Use an environment whose first setup command returns a nonzero returncode. Observe that setup continues to the next command and returns normally.
recommendation: Check every setup command's returncode and raise a setup failure immediately on nonzero status, identifying the failed command without exposing sensitive output.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The supplied test covers an unrelated dictionary merge helper and contains no environment setup failure scenarios.
suggestedRegressionTest: Exercise successful setup sequences and failures at different positions. Assert that a failure prevents subsequent commands and propagates to the caller.
minimumFixScope: Validate execution results in MiniSWEAgent.setup and add setup lifecycle coverage.

history.reasoning: The evidence file still exists. setup now checks returncode and immediately raises AgentSetupError at lines 602–607, supporting the intended repair.
